claim.claim-text: a processor removably electrically coupled to the electrically conductive trace, wherein the processor is configured to be activated in response to an alteration of the electrically conductive trace; and a wireless communication device configured to wirelessly communicate, to a computing device, information associated with the alteration in the electrically conductive trace.

2. The system of claim 1, wherein the disposable label includes a plurality of first conductive pads electrically coupled to the electrically conductive trace, wherein the reusable housing includes a plurality of spring contacts electrically coupled to the processor and removably electrically coupled to the plurality of first conductive pads, and wherein the reusable housing includes a rigid deformable clip removably clipped onto an exterior surface of the injection device.

3. The system of claim 1, wherein the disposable label includes at least one connector extending from the disposable label, wherein the reusable housing includes at least one port in which the at least one connector is received, and wherein the at least one connector includes a plurality of first electrical connectors electrically coupled to the electrically conductive trace and removably electrically coupled to a plurality of second electrical connectors of the at least one port, wherein the plurality of second electrical connectors is electrically coupled to the at least one processor.

4. The system of claim 3, wherein the at least one connector includes a plurality of connectors, and wherein the at least one port includes a plurality of ports corresponding to the plurality of connectors, wherein each connector of the plurality of connectors includes a single first electrical connector, and wherein each port of the plurality of ports includes a single second electrical connector.
5. The system of claim 3, wherein the at least one connector is press fit in the at least one port.

6. The system of claim 1, wherein the disposable label includes a plurality of first conductive pads electrically coupled to the electrically conductive trace, wherein the reusable housing includes a plurality of second conductive pads coupled to the processor and removably electrically coupled to the plurality of first conductive pads via a conductive adhesive applied to at least one of the plurality of first conductive pads and the plurality of second conductive pads.
7. The system of claim 1, wherein the disposable label includes an adhesive layer.

8. The system of claim 1, wherein the disposable label includes a further electrically conductive trace, wherein a first portion the further electrically conductive trace is configured to be altered in response to a second operation of the injection device different than the first operation of the injection device, and wherein the processor is removably electrically coupled to the further electrically conductive trace, wherein the first operation of the injection device includes removal of a cap or a cover of the injection device, and wherein the second operation of the injection device includes actuation of a button of the injection device or a deployment of a needle shield of the injection device.

9. The system of claim 1, wherein a second portion of the electrically conductive trace is configured to be altered in response to a second operation of the injection device different than the first operation of the injection device, wherein the first operation of the injection device includes removal of a cap or a cover of the injection device, and wherein the second operation of the injection device includes actuation of a button of the injection device or a deployment of a needle shield of the injection device.

10. The system of claim 1, wherein the disposable label includes at least one sensor, wherein the at least one sensor includes at least one of the following: an optical sensor, a temperature sensor, a force sensor, or any combination thereof, and wherein the at least one sensor is electrically coupled to the electrically conductive trace.

11. The system of claim 1, wherein the reusable housing includes at least one sensor, wherein the at least one sensor includes at least one of the following: a vibration sensor, an accelerometer, an optical sensor, a magnetic sensor, or any combination thereof.
12. The system of claim 1, wherein the alteration of the first portion of the electrically conductive trace includes a break in the first portion of the electrically conductive trace.
13. The system of claim 1, further comprising: a container housing the sensor assembly.

14. The system of claim 13, wherein the disposable label includes a further electrically conductive trace, wherein a portion of the label including the further electrically conductive trace is attached to the container, wherein a first portion the further electrically conductive trace is configured to be altered in response to removal of the sensor assembly from the container, and wherein the processor is removably electrically coupled to the further electrically conductive trace.

15. The system of claim 13, wherein a second portion of the electrically conductive trace is configured to be altered in response to removal of the sensor assembly from the container, and wherein a portion of the disposable label is attached to the container.
